Yoopta Edtior

This is such a great and valuable product for every single developer worldwide! Exceptional work! Good luck to the entire team with the launch!

Report [...] Hey everyone! 👋 Building a developer community is tough. I know because I’ve been there. You start with a vision, but getting the right people in the door and keeping them engaged can be a real challenge. That’s why we built daily.dev Squads—to make it easier to create a thriving developer community from day one. With Squads, you get a head start by tapping into a global network where developers are already active. Over 1 in 50 developers worldwide start their day on daily.dev, and during our beta alone, more than 10,000 Squads were created.🤯 That shows how much people need a space like this. Here’s what I think really makes Squads special: • Discoverability: Squads are integrated into the daily.dev ecosystem, so your community is immediately visible to developers already on the platform.
